title: Combat climax
description: An ambush on the road turns into a fight at the ford: the player charges, takes a risk, then tries to end it. Real rolls, real cost.

steps.say: I take the ford road out of the square, moving carefully and watching the reeds for anyone waiting there.
If anyone is there, I don't wait for them: I draw and go straight for the biggest one.
I shout that the reeve's men are right behind me and give them one chance to run.
